description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution across two components of the Paper Copilot system, labeled "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment." The chart is divided into two slices: a large orange slice representing "Reduction" with a value of 60.9 seconds (69.92%) and a smaller blue slice representing "Efficient deployment" with a value of 26.2 seconds (30.08%). The blue slice is slightly separated from the rest of the pie, emphasizing its portion. Both slices are clearly labeled with their respective names and time values, including the percentage of the total time they represent. The chart effectively visualizes the proportion of time spent on each component, highlighting that the reduction process accounts for the majority of the time.
